name: TypeScript Code Reviewer
description: Reviews TypeScript code for bugs, security vulnerabilities, and style violations. Provides structured feedback with severity levels, line references, and actionable fix suggestions.

bug-detection.description: Identifies logical bugs, type errors, null reference risks, off-by-one errors, race conditions, and other correctness issues in TypeScript code

tests.description: Detects potential null/undefined reference when accessing optional property without guard
Detects off-by-one error in array iteration
Detects missing await on async function call

security-analysis.description: Identifies security vulnerabilities including injection attacks, insecure data handling, XSS vectors, and unsafe deserialization

tests.description: Detects SQL injection vulnerability from string concatenation in query
Detects XSS vulnerability from unsanitized user input rendered as HTML
Detects hardcoded API key in source code

style-violations.description: Identifies TypeScript style issues including naming conventions, code organization, any-type usage, missing return types, and general readability concerns

tests.description: Flags excessive use of 'any' type that defeats TypeScript's type safety
Flags poor naming conventions and missing type annotations
Should not flag major style issues on reasonably clean code

structured-output.description: Produces well-organized review output with categorized findings, severity levels, and actionable recommendations

tests.description: Output should categorize findings and include severity or priority indicators
Review should include concrete fix suggestions, not just problem identification
